update.title: Software Updates
update.ui_hint:
The built-in UI ships with the app; once a hot-update URL is configured you can get new UI versions without upgrading the app. When auto-update is on, new versions are checked and applied at startup.
You can always restore the built-in UI shipped with the app.
update.ui_url_hint: Leave empty to follow the update channel (stable/preview); or set a ui.json manifest URL
update.ui_restore_desc: This deletes the downloaded hot-updated UI and immediately restores the built-in UI shipped with the app. If auto-update stays on, updates will be checked again on next startup. Continue?
update.app_hint: Two channels are available: stable and preview. With auto-update on, new versions are downloaded automatically; installing always requires your confirmation and can be postponed.
update.downloaded_ready: Version {0} has been downloaded and is ready to install
update.installing_hint: Installing will exit the app and launch the installer; the app restarts automatically afterwards.
